run.title: Run it from a terminal
run.lede: Call this script with the hoody CLI or curl.
run.key: This script has a key: put your key in place of <your key> before you run the command. The Hub never shows your key.
run.note.folder: The hoody CLI reaches scripts in folder 1 only, so this one has the curl line.
run.note.typed: This script has its own options. To see its CLI command, run hoody exec --help.
run.note.typedKeyed: The hoody CLI can't send a key to a script with its own options yet. Use the curl line.
run.note.unknownKeyed: The Hub can't tell if the hoody CLI can send this script's key. Use the curl line.
run.note.noName: The hoody CLI has no command for this address. Use the curl line.
run.note.clash: Another script's address gives the same hoody CLI command, so it could call that one. Use the curl line.
run.cliCheck: The Hub can't see every script the hoody CLI can. Before you rely on this command, check with hoody exec --help that its name is this script's.
run.fill: This address has parts to fill in: put a value in place of each <name> before you run the command.
run.testOpens: Opens a new terminal on {{computer}}. Copy a command above, paste it there and press Enter.
run.noTerminal: The terminal address of {{computer}} is not known here.
run.note.unroutable: This script's file name has characters an address can't carry, so nothing can call it by address.
